contentBase64.description: The file contents, base64-encoded (no data: URI prefix).

title.description: Display title stored on PortalDocument.name. Defaults to fileName when omitted.

propertyId.description: A managed property the document is about. Omit for a portfolio-level doc.

reason.example: Quote above budget — please re-quote with cheaper parts.

propertyId.description: The property this tenant is linked to (via their application), if any.

applicationId.description: The application that anchored this tenant login.

hasMore.description: Whether a further page exists after this one.

password.description: Initial password to share with the tenant. Hashed with Argon2; never persisted in clear text.

applicationId.description: Approved rental application — links the new login to the applicant Person and advances onboarding.

content.example: 66 Berry Street — tenant moving out 31 August 2026

pctElapsed.description: Unrounded fraction of the term elapsed. Format for display only.

citation.description: The rule THIS fee comes from. Never cite a rule from elsewhere for it.

minDays.description: The NSW minimum notice days for this tenancy.

citation.description: The rule THIS minimum comes from (s96 fixed term / s97 periodic).

creditDays.description: Days paid beyond the vacate date.

propertyId.description: Echo this back as request `context.propertyId` on the next turn so Gii keeps the subject without re-resolving the address.

dailyRentDisplay.description: The daily rate as displayed. Render this verbatim; do not re-round.

breakFee.description: Null unless this is a genuine breach with a quotable fee.

missing.description: Facts the engine lacked. Gii asks for exactly these rather than guessing.

conflicts.description: Lease facts where the tenancy agreement and property registry disagree.

reply.example: That is a break lease — 243 of 365 days elapsed (66.6%), so a 2-week fee of $2,000.00 applies.

assessment.description: The deterministic assessment behind the reply, for rendering. Null when the turn produced no assessment.

available.description: Whether this server can transcribe hold-to-talk audio.

provider.description: Which ASR would run; null when none is configured.

languageHint.description: ISO language hint (`en`, `zh`) — omit to auto-detect.

text.description: Empty when the clip produced no words — see `outcome`.

outcome.description: Why the text is empty: `no_speech` (the provider heard nothing), `provider_failed`, or `empty_audio`. A 200 with no text is a normal outcome; only a 503 means this server cannot transcribe at all.

summary.example: Maintenance quote awaiting your approval (urgent) — Kitchen mixer tap replacement
summary.description: Plain-language status. Any figures in it are the DB’s, not the model’s.

reference.description: Business reference (order number) where one exists; null otherwise.

total.description: Total cases needing the actor’s attention.

role.description: Role key from the verified token.

personId.description: External-party domain anchor (Person id); null for internal staff.

token.description: The opaque provider push token (FCM / APNs / Expo).
The push token to remove (e.g. on logout).

body.example: 12/45 Campbell Parade, Bondi Beach has been assigned to you.

updated.description: How many notifications were flipped to read.

submitted_at.description: ISO 8601 submission time. Omit to use the current Australia/Sydney wall clock with offset.

idempotency_key.description: UUID v4 idempotency key. Omit to generate a fresh key for this test request.
